text:
39. The following table contains a non-exhaustive list of additional factual elements which may
apply to the offence and the offender. The court should consider which of these factors apply,
together with any other factors which, in the view of the court, aggravate or mitigate the
offence or sentence. In some cases this may move the headline sentence outside the range
selected at step 2.
